subject: Three brain regions synchronised during sleep to consolidate memory
script: From Agewell Brief: Three brain regions synchronised during sleep to consolidate memory. A first-of-its-kind study shows three brain regions working together during sleep to strengthen memories—and how epilepsy can disrupt that process. Three brain regions cooperate during sleep to strengthen memories. Epilepsy can interfere with this memory-strengthening process. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
